scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @parishodh/shared run build && concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "pnpm --filter @parishodh/api dev" "pnpm --filter @parishodh/web dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @parishodh/shared run build && pnpm -r run test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @parishodh/shared run build && pnpm --filter @parishodh/api exec prisma generate && playwright test
